task.description: What to do, in plain language, e.g. 'open a PR for this branch' or 'triage issue #42'.

repo.description: owner/repo slug, if not already implied by the current working directory's git remote.

summary.description: What the agent did, in one or two sentences.

actionsTaken.description: Ordered list of concrete steps performed (commands run, URLs created).

url.description: Link to the created/updated PR or issue, if any.
